facts.fact: TechBooky reports MTN Nigeria's Dabengwa Data Centre in Lagos, built from 96 prefabricated containers in its initial phase, opened in July 2025 and serves enterprise clients.

TechBooky reports the Uptime Institute awarded MTN Nigeria's Dabengwa Data Centre in Lagos Tier III Certification for Constructed Facility (it also holds Tier III Design Documentation), announced 2025-09-25.
